title: Retries stop hammering a provider that is down
what: Calls to the AI provider now go through a circuit breaker: after five failures in a row, calls fail fast for 30 seconds instead of retrying.
improves: A provider outage no longer stacks up slow retries, so pages that call the AI stay responsive and the quota is not burned on doomed calls.

risk.scenario: A short blip of five quick failures opens the breaker and real requests fail for 30 seconds although the provider has recovered.
risk.blastRadius: Every feature that calls the AI provider.

evidence.detail: resilience.test.ts 'opens after five failures' fails with the breaker removed and passes with it.

suggestions.text: Half-open state lets a single probe through; add a test that two concurrent probes do not both pass.

title: Logs are scrubbed of secrets
what: The logger runs every message through the shared redactor before writing it.
improves: API keys and tokens pasted into errors no longer end up in log files.

risk.scenario: A long, random-looking id is mistaken for a secret and shown as [REDACTED] in logs.

evidence.detail: Every Logger method calls redact() first; logger tests pass.

raise: A test that logs a real-looking ghp_ token and asserts it is not in the output.
